note: naive first-cut kernels: II=1 fully unrolled int64 MAC, padded-array-in-BRAM, batch N=2 folded in. Feasibility probe, NOT the final architecture.
finding: 3 of 11 layers already exceed the 53.2K LUT budget (148%); pw_3 alone is 65%. int64 per-multiplier MAC and full unrolling are the cost drivers. Naive HLS cannot fit the student on xc7z020; a dataflow architecture (DSP48 int8 MAC with shared int32/int64 accumulate, line buffers, layer reuse, batch=1) is required, consistent with docs/方案/03 section 4.

v1_naive.note: II=1 on COUT loop, int64 MAC per multiplier, batch=2

v2d_chunkpipe.note: 8x8 ap_int MAC, chunk pipeline, but II=32 (single m_axi port)

v3_bram_tile.note: II=1 satisfied, depth 6; transposed weights, BRAM-resident tile, int32 shared acc

v3_conclusion: Dataflow architecture fits: 12% LUT / 12 DSP / II=1 for the largest PW layer. Whole-net with layer-reused array is feasible on xc7z020 per docs/方案/03 section 4. CSim bit-exact at every iteration (contract intact).
